name: pl-dicom_audit
title: DICOM anonymization audit
description: A ChRIS plugin that records what pl-dicom_anonymize changed and scans its output for leaks

parameters.name: originalDir
parameters.help: Subdirectory of inputdir holding the original (pre-anonymization) tree. Default: auto-detect -- the one top-level subdirectory that is not the anonymized tree.

parameters.name: anonymizedDir
parameters.help: Subdirectory of inputdir holding the anonymized tree (pl-dicom_anonymize output). Default: auto-detect -- the directory containing deidentification_summary.json.

parameters.name: acknowledgeRetainedTags
parameters.help: Comma-separated DICOM keywords the anonymization policy keeps on purpose; the leak scan ignores matches inside these elements. Use the same value given to pl-dicom_anonymize.

parameters.name: residualMinLength
parameters.help: Shortest original value (or name component) the leak scan searches for.

parameters.name: skipPixelCheck
parameters.help: Do not check that PixelData is byte-identical between the two trees.

parameters.name: failOnLeak
parameters.help: Exit 1 if the audit finds a leak (original values in the anonymized headers, UIDs, paths or non-DICOM files), incomplete pairing (any original DICOM without a verified anonymized counterpart, or the reverse), or an integrity error (pixel mismatch, conflicting UID mapping). The audit is always written first. Without this flag the plugin exits 0 and the result is in audit_summary.json (overall_status).
